b.clean: Incident summary: At about 11 in the morning, the search service started returning empty results for every query. Customers noticed because the product pages showed no related items. The cause turned out to be an expired certificate on the Elasticsearch cluster. The client was silently swallowing the TLS error and returning an empty list instead of raising, so our monitoring saw a healthy service with zero results. We renewed the certificate at 11:40 and results came back. Follow-ups: make the client raise on connection errors, add an alert on the ratio of empty results, and add certificate expiry to the monitoring dashboard with a 30-day warning.
